content.text: I have a clear understanding of the data and the user's request. I will now construct a SQL query to answer the question. The query will first calculate the required statistics for each state (total aliens, friendly vs. hostile counts, and average age). Then, it will identify the top 10 states by alien population. Finally, it will count how many of these top 10 states meet the criteria of having an average alien age greater than 200 and a higher number of friendly than hostile aliens.

args.sql:
WITH state_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    COUNT(*) AS total_aliens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS friendly_aliens,
    SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hostile_aliens,
    AVG(age) AS avg_age
  FROM city_legislation.main.alien_data
  WHERE state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state
),
ranked_states AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_aliens DESC) as state_rank
  FROM state_metrics
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM ranked_states
WHERE
  state_rank <= 10
  AND avg_age > 200
  AND friendly_aliens > hostile_aliens;
